PLAY · ANIMAL TRACKING

Raccoon’s Footprint Hunt

Whose footprint is that? Draw a line from each animal to the print its feet make!

HOW TO DO IT

Read, then draw.

Whose footprint is that? Draw a line from each animal to the print its feet make!

Look at the feet first!

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear appear right here and work straight on the picture. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This adventure is cleared for you the moment you save your finished picture. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! Trail solved! Your saved work is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in the library.

REACTIONS

How did it go?

One tap, no writing, no name. Pick the face that matches how it went — reactions are counted instantly and stay anonymous.

      FOR GROWN-UPS

      Why this adventure helps.

      Tracking is detective play with muddy real-world payoffs: after rain, hunt for prints and guess the maker. Webbed vs paw vs hoof is a shape story worth retelling.

      Prefer paper? The Raccoon’s Footprint Hunt worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
